description: Android activity class 'SplashActivity' that displays a splash screen with custom UI elements and animations for a TV app, then transitions to 'HomeActivity'.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for displaying a splash screen with animated UI elements tailored for Android TV, then launching the main activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash screen UI, sets up animations, and schedules transition to 'HomeActivity' after a delay.

methods.name: createSplashGradient
methods.description: Creates a vertical gradient drawable for the splash background, blending ocean blue with a near-white background.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on device density.
